servicesIntro: Upkeep for like-new boats. Restoration for weathered ones. Protection to keep them that way.

services.name: Detailing Packages
services.text: Auto detailing and cleaning packages for sedans, trucks, SUVs, minivans, motorcycles, RVs, boats and more.

services.name: Ceramic Coating
services.text: Interior, exterior and engine bay coatings in 1, 3, 6 and 10-year applications for a lasting gloss and protection.

services.name: Paint Correction
services.text: Surface scratches, faded paint, bad clear coat and swirl marks corrected to bring the exterior back to like new.

services.name: Mobile Paint Repair
services.text: Exterior and interior paint repair done at your home or work.

services.name: Headlight Restoration
services.text: Haziness and yellowing from oxidation removed to bring headlights back to brand new condition.

services.name: Engine Bay Detail
services.text: A deep clean, steam clean and detail of the engine bay.
